split.sampling: All rows from the sole published split, in manifest order. Each question uses the complete text table.

scoring.procedure: The archive supplies a zero-shot evaluation and a supplemental exact-match rule. A match requires equal strings or equal finite decimal values. Units are retained.
scoring.aggregate: The lower bound divides observed correct by 3653 per model. The upper bound includes pending items. The conditional rate uses valid scored responses.

rights.evidence: The archived Hugging Face dataset card declares MIT. The archived repository inventory lists no separate license file.
